verdict.rationale: Vendor docs extensively claim AI-generated insights from data across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Researcher, and Analyst, with connectors to OneDrive, Gmail, etc. (copilot-docs-2, copilot-docs-4, copilot-docs-5, copilot-docs-6, copilot-docs-7). However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict this: one user found Copilot in Word 'couldn't do anything except append to the end of the document... couldn't create tables... What a failure!' (copilot-comm-4), another calls Outlook's summarize feature 'so bad' (copilot-comm-5), and another says they 'never found a use case for Copilot' despite daily AI use (copilot-comm-9), while one positive report praises cross-document data fetching (copilot-comm-7). Missing for 10: consistent independent verification that insights are reliably accurate/useful across products, and resolution of the mixed real-world quality reports.
